reason: I already pay an agency to run Instagram for my outlets, and my marketing person handles them. I'm not going to switch to an AI beta from a small team and approve posts on WhatsApp between orders at the counter.
objection: AI captions and a stranger picking creators for my brand across several outlets. If a bad post or a freeloading creator goes out under my name, my agency answers for it. Here, who answers?
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another Bengaluru chain my size that the comment-to-WhatsApp enquiries actually brought in more bookings than our agency gets, so I could hand it to my marketing person as an add-on, not a replacement.
